verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents Client Credentials/M2M flow with scopes for machine identities, RBAC/FGA for fine-grained permissions, and a dedicated 'Auth0 for AI Agents' product line explicitly describing OAuth 2.0 scoped API access 'preventing agents from having broad, unrestricted access to user data' plus unique per-agent identities and Token Vault-managed scoped third-party tokens. This directly matches issuing least-privilege credentials for agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that agent-scoped credential issuance works as documented in practice, and no community evidence specifically testing this AI-agent scoping feature.
